title: Ferritin

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: A ferritin blood test measures the level of ferritin, a protein that stores iron in the body. It shows how much iron is stored, and much of the body's ferritin is kept in the liver.
context: A result outside the usual range does not always mean a condition that needs care. Certain medicines can lower or raise ferritin levels.
aboveRange: Higher levels can be associated with having too much iron stored in the body
May be associated with inflammation, such as from an infection or surgery
May be associated with an autoimmune condition, some liver conditions, or cancer
May be associated with obesity, alcohol use disorder, or an overactive thyroid
belowRange: Lower levels may be associated with iron deficiency anemia
May be associated with another condition related to low iron levels
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
